sentences.text: Evtepia gabavorous is a human gut bacterium described as a consumer of the neurotransmitter gamma-aminobutyric acid, or GABA.
GABA is both produced and consumed inside the gut community, and a co-cultured gut isolate grew on GABA as its only supporting nutrient.
The species has been detected in stool metagenomes of young adults in China in a study of microplastic exposure.
A meta-analysis of five case-control studies covering 1007 faecal samples reported elevated GABA-consuming species, particularly this one, in Parkinson disease.
